title: Sparkly crystal ball
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
<defs>
<radialGradient id='ballGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
<stop offset='0%' stop-color='#d0f0ff'/>
<stop offset='40%' stop-color='#7ec8e3'/>
<stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3a6fd8'/>
</radialGradient>
<radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
<stop offset='0%' stop-color='#b3e6ff' stop-opacity='0.6'/>
<stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b3e6ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
</radialGradient>
</defs>

<!-- Soft glow behind ball -->
<circle cx='50' cy='52' r='38' fill='url(#glow)'/>

<!-- Stand base -->
<ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='22' ry='7' fill='#c8963e'/>
<ellipse cx='50' cy='83' rx='20' ry='6' fill='#e8b44a'/>
<rect x='36' y='76' width='28' height='8' rx='3' fill='#d6a03a'/>
<ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='14' ry='4' fill='#f0c860'/>
<ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='10' ry='2.5' fill='#fce090'/>

<!-- Crystal ball -->
<circle cx='50' cy='48' r='30' fill='url(#ballGrad)'/>

<!-- Highlight on ball -->
<ellipse cx='40' cy='38' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#e8f8ff' opacity='0.7'/>
<ellipse cx='38' cy='35' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>

<!-- Inner reflection swirl -->
<path d='M58 60 Q65 52 58 44 Q52 38 56 32' stroke='#a0d8f0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' opacity='0.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
<path d='M44 62 Q38 56 42 48' stroke='#a0d8f0' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' opacity='0.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

<!-- Sparkles around the ball -->
<!-- Sparkle 1: top left -->
<g transform='translate(22,22)'>
<line x1='0' y1='-6' x2='0' y2='6' stroke='#fffbe0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
<line x1='-6' y1='0' x2='6' y2='0' stroke='#fffbe0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
<line x1='-4' y1='-4' x2='4' y2='4' stroke='#ffe860' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
<line x1='4' y1='-4' x2='-4' y2='4' stroke='#ffe860' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
<circle cx='0' cy='0' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
</g>

<!-- Sparkle 2: top right -->
<g transform='translate(78,26)'>
<line x1='0' y1='-5' x2='0' y2='5' stroke='#fffbe0' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
<line x1='-5' y1='0' x2='5' y2='0' stroke='#fffbe0' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
<line x1='-3.5' y1='-3.5' x2='3.5' y2='3.5' stroke='#ffe860' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
<line x1='3.5' y1='-3.5' x2='-3.5' y2='3.5' stroke='#ffe860' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
<circle cx='0' cy='0' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
</g>

<!-- Sparkle 3: right side -->
<g transform='translate(84,55)'>
<line x1='0' y1='-4' x2='0' y2='4' stroke='#fffbe0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
<line x1='-4' y1='0' x2='4' y2='0' stroke='#fffbe0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
<circle cx='0' cy='0' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
</g>

<!-- Sparkle 4: bottom left -->
<g transform='translate(18,62)'>
<line x1='0' y1='-4' x2='0' y2='4' stroke='#fffbe0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
<line x1='-4' y1='0' x2='4' y2='0' stroke='#fffbe0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
<line x1='-2.5' y1='-2.5' x2='2.5' y2='2.5' stroke='#ffe860' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
<line x1='2.5' y1='-2.5' x2='-2.5' y2='2.5' stroke='#ffe860' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
<circle cx='0' cy='0' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
</g>

<!-- Sparkle 5: top center small -->
<g transform='translate(52,14)'>
<line x1='0' y1='-3' x2='0' y2='3' stroke='#fffbe0' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
<line x1='-3' y1='0' x2='3' y2='0' stroke='#fffbe0' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
<circle cx='0' cy='0' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
</g>

<!-- Sparkle 6: bottom right -->
<g transform='translate(76,72)'>
<line x1='0' y1='-3.5' x2='0' y2='3.5' stroke='#fffbe0' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
<line x1='-3.5' y1='0' x2='3.5' y2='0' stroke='#fffbe0' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
<circle cx='0' cy='0' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
</g>

<!-- Tiny dot sparkles -->
<circle cx='30' cy='16' r='1.5' fill='#fffbe0'/>
<circle cx='68' cy='14' r='1.2' fill='#ffe860'/>
<circle cx='90' cy='40' r='1' fill='#fffbe0'/>
<circle cx='12' cy='44' r='1.2' fill='#ffe860'/>
<circle cx='62' cy='84' r='1' fill='#fffbe0'/>
<circle cx='28' cy='78' r='1.3' fill='#ffe860'/>
</svg>
